_comment: Catalog of shape types, grouped by family. Drives the Shapes tray in vortex/wall/src/pages/clinic/pathways/Pathways.jsx AND vortex/wall/src/pages/clinic/patterns/Patterns.jsx — pick a family tab, drag one of its types onto the canvas. Every 'call' type is something the clinic does (an outgoing action), so they all render the same small outgoing-arrow badge on the circle, unconditionally — there's no incoming/outgoing distinction (no `subfamily` field) left in this catalog. `emoji` renders inside the shape; a type with no emoji falls back to its name printed inside the shape instead. `defaultWhen` seeds a freshly dropped Pathways node's `when` (see pathways.json's _comment for the `when` shape) — Patterns nodes ignore it, they have no `when`. The 'condition' family is for pattern-building only (a gap, an absence of a follow-up, an open referral — not a real call/message/visit event) but lives in the same shared catalog as the rest. A pathway's fixed first node — family 'entry' — is deliberately left out of this catalog: it isn't a draggable type, always renders the same bell glyph regardless of type, and has no `when`. Patterns.jsx and patterns.json still track incoming vs. outgoing on their own pattern nodes directly (a patient's incoming call is a real historical fact its matcher depends on) — that `subfamily` lives on those nodes, independent of this catalog.
